title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory record streaming to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
description: Stream Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory long-term records to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and sync an Amazon DynamoDB table with AWS Lambda, including deletions.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory extracts long-term records with the built-in semantic and user-preference strategies and publishes a created, updated or deleted event for each record to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
An AWS Lambda event source mapping filters on the documented event types and skips the StreamingEnabled validation event.
The AWS Lambda function upserts or deletes an Amazon DynamoDB item keyed by memory record ID, so deletions reach the table even though deleted events carry no actor or namespace.
